atom.description: Liveblocks Cursor + PresenceCursor pattern (Apache-2.0): arrow SVG with fill='currentColor' inheriting from --lb-cursor-color CSS custom property, presence stored as normalized 0-1 coordinates multiplied by ResizeObserver-tracked container size, spring-interpolated via makeCursorSpring() to smooth chunky WebSocket packets, rendered with translate3d for GPU compositing.
